survey: A stone park game table with two stone stools on grass beside a path. The table is a square slab with a rounded edge and an inset checkerboard on top. It sits centred on a single square pillar, which stands on a wider square base on the grass. The table is seen from a high three-quarter angle, so the board faces up and toward the camera. Each stool is a round cylinder with a slightly wider round seat, and both stand upright on the grass, one on each side of the table, with contact shadows. The board shows alternating blue and cream squares inside a stone border. I could not enlarge the board (the crop command was not approved), so I did not verify that it is exactly 8×8. At this size it looks plausible.
